technology_name: A METHOD FOR THE VISIBLE LIGHT-INDUCED SELECTIVE DEGRADATION OF POLY(PROPYLENE CARBONATE) TO ITS MONOMER PROPYLENE CARBONATE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard plastic recycling techniques require intense energy footprints or harsh acids, which break down polymers into unrecoverable material sludges.
description: A green chemical recycling protocol utilizing hafnium dioxide (HfO2) as a photo-active catalyst under continuous, coherent visible light to cleanly cleave chemical bonds and convert poly(propylene carbonate) back to its pure monomer.
applications: Circular economy plastic recycling plants, zero-waste packaging loops, electronic scrap chemical recovery, and green polymer manufacturing processes.
